description: Abstract class for implementing request-response pattern endpoints in an AMQP-based service, handling link setup, message processing, authorization, and response forwarding within the Eclipse Hono framework.

classes.name: RequestResponseEndpoint
classes.description: Abstract base class for AMQP request-response endpoints, managing link setup, message handling, authorization, and response forwarding within Eclipse Hono.

methods.name: onLinkAttach
methods.description: Configures and handles incoming link attachments for request messages, enforcing QoS policies and setting message handlers.

methods.name: handleRequestMessage
methods.description: Processes incoming request messages, verifies format, authorization, and payload, then forwards to service via event bus and sends responses.

methods.name: getServiceInvocationException
methods.description: Converts various exceptions into ServiceInvocationException with appropriate HTTP error codes.

methods.name: isAuthorized
methods.description: Checks if the client is authorized to perform the requested operation; default delegates to AuthorizationService.

methods.name: extractResponse
methods.description: Extracts EventBusMessage from event bus reply, expecting JSON object.

methods.name: filterResponse
methods.description: Allows subclasses to filter or modify responses before sending to clients; default returns the original response.

methods.name: onLinkAttach
methods.description: Establishes a sender link for responses, validating reply-to address and managing sender lifecycle.

methods.name: onConnectionClosed
methods.description: Cleans up senders associated with a closed connection.

methods.name: getSenderForConnection
methods.description: Retrieves an active sender link for a given connection and reply-to address.

methods.name: registerSenderForReplyTo
methods.description: Associates a ProtonSender with a reply-to address for response routing.

methods.name: unregisterSenderForReplyTo
methods.description: Removes the sender association for a reply-to address.

methods.name: deallocateAllSendersForConnection
methods.description: Removes all sender links associated with a specific connection.

methods.name: flowCreditToRequestor
methods.description: Replenishes flow credits on a receiver link to allow further message reception.

methods.name: isValidReplyToAddress
methods.description: Validates reply-to address format; default requires three segments (endpoint, tenant, resource).
